One of the best starts for Austria involves Royal marrying Bohemia (who start the game in a interregnum) but not allying them. To cheese Secret of Mana, all you have to do is realize that if you open the spell window of the casters while not controlling them, you can start casting another spell as soon as the mana spirit goes away, as opposed to when they finish standing. Because of this, you can chain cast spells and the effected enemies will remain frozen while the spell animation executes. If the spell animation is longer than the caster recovery time, then you can chain cast without ever giving the enemy a chance to move (caster recovery is much slower for multi projectile spells like Fireball because they don't get up from kneeling til every projectile hits). Most elements have a spell that this works for, Freeze is particularly great for everything not resistant to it because the animation is short enough that you don't have to wait too long for it to finish if you're not chain casting, but it is long enough to chain without allowing any movement. Later on, once you know which enemies are susceptible to mana drain, you can effortlessly clear through trash and still have full mana when you reach bosses.
